FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) ACT 1984

FEDERAL ROADS (PRIVATE MANAGEMENT) (COLLECTION OF TOLLS)

(CHERASKAJANG HIGHWAY) (AMENDMENT) (NO. 3) ORDER 2015

IN exercise of the powers conferred by section 2 of the Federal Roads

(Private Management) Act 1984 [Act 306], the Minister makes the following order:

Citation and commencement

1. (1) This order may be cited as the Federal Roads (Private Management)

(Collection of Tolls) (CherasKajang Highway) (Amendment) (No. 3) Order 2015.

(2) This Order comes into operation on 15 October 2015.

Amendment paragraph 2

2. The Federal Roads (Private Management) (Collection of Tolls) (CherasKajang

Highway) Order 1999 [P. U. (A) 15/1999], which is referred to as the "principal Order"

in this Order, is amended in subparagraph 2(1)—

(a) by substituting for the words "column (2) of the First Schedule according to

the concession years as specified in column (1) of the Schedule" the words

"columns (2) and (3) of the First Schedule"; and

(b) by substituting for the words "column (2) of the First Schedule" the words

"column (1) of the First Schedule".

Substitution of First Schedule

3. The principal Order is amended by substituting for First Schedule the following

Schedule:

"FIRST SCHEDULE

[subparagraph 2(1)]

RATES OF TOLL FOR THE CONCESSION PERIOD FROM 15 OCTOBER 2015

UNTIL 19 SEPTEMBER 2027

For the purpose of calculating the number of axles and wheels of a vehicle, the axles and

wheels of any trailer towed by the vehicle shall be calculated as part of the axles and

wheels of the vehicle.".
